design:
R6 the two coverage numbers the main text quotes, at ten thousand replicates.

Design fixed before running (2026-09-16, written 11:15 EDT). snap-r6-joint-share measured recipe-clustered
coverage at the corners the data allows, with 4,000 replicates per cell, which leaves a Monte Carlo
standard error near 0.0035. Two of those four numbers are now quoted in the main text, the 0.9367 at the
band-share bound of 0.044 and the 0.9490 at the joint corner where recipe sharing sits at 0.114 as well,
and the limitation they support turns on whether coverage there is a point below nominal or two. At the
current precision a reader cannot separate 0.937 from 0.943, so the sentence rests on noise the paper
does not own. This run repeats the identical two cells at 12,000 replicates with a fresh seed, which cuts
the Monte Carlo standard error to about 0.0021. The generator, the four interval constructions and the
shipped-estimator check are unchanged, so the two runs can be compared directly and pooled if they agree.
Seed 20260947 and a cell offset of twenty one hundred keep the draws distinct from the first pass.
